item.arcanestaffs.fire_staff.lore: Hurls a beam of fire that burns everything it touches.
item.arcanestaffs.ice_staff.lore: Freezes and slows enemies where the beam lands.
item.arcanestaffs.lightning_staff.lore: Calls down lightning wherever you point.
item.arcanestaffs.earth_staff.lore: Sends a shockwave through the ground that launches foes.
item.arcanestaffs.wind_staff.lore: Blasts enemies away. Sneak while casting to dash through the air.
